anti_overlap: Do not design the detailed resistance or recovery equations; fd-delta-avulsion-footprint-cox owns the physical mechanism test.
Do not re-litigate the reported arithmetic unless the file contains an internal contradiction; the measured values are premises for this review.
Do not propose implementation patches or benchmark-run orchestration; focus on causal warrant, construct continuity, and decision criteria.
decision_lens: Accept a resolution only when its mechanism addresses the measured loss of terminal outcome variance, its certification claim is stated without equivocation, and the evidence ladder can distinguish the proposal from a merely relocated threshold or newly tuned constant.
distance_rationale: This is a centuries-refined non-Western oral practice for testing whether a reason genuinely entails a conclusion under adversarial questioning. It is institutionally and historically remote from software benchmarks, simulation calibration, and modern statistical model selection.
expected_isomorphisms: Thesis, reason, and pervasion map to a candidate resolution, its claimed mechanism, and the claim that the mechanism must restore the certified property.
A valid counterexample maps to the measured falsification of topology, propagation_rate, crisis_threshold, or threshold re-cutting.
Changing the thesis under challenge maps to replacing OUTCOME certification with PATH certification without explicitly retiring the old construct.
An unestablished subject maps to option A's unknown variance-collapse onset, which prevents a justified edge-sampling probability.
A consequence that forces contradiction maps to accepting both deterministic terminal outcomes and a continued claim of outcome uncertainty.
focus: Causal adjudication of the four Stage B resolutions, especially whether each conclusion follows from the measured evidence and whether gate changes preserve or replace the certification claim.
name: fd-tibetan-debate-entailment-cox
persona: Apply the perspective of a Tibetan monastic debate disciplinarian trained in pramāṇa, where a proposed thesis must be supported by a reason that is present in the subject, pervades the claimed consequence, and survives counterexample. Treat falsified levers as defeated reasons, construct changes as new theses, and unresolved measurements as explicit limits on entailment.
review_areas: Test the pervasion claim behind every option: establish whether the proposed intervention must alter final survivor identity or cat_share variance, rather than merely moving T0, changing routes, or renaming the certified property.

Separate theses that are often conflated: authoritative geographic coverage, timing dispersion, terminal outcome uncertainty, epicenter diversity, and product-level replay value. Require an explicit choice when one is traded for another.

Audit option B as a possible construct substitution: determine whether certifying PATH instead of OUTCOME is defensible product policy, and require the old outcome claim to be retired rather than presented as preserved.

Treat the topology, propagation_rate, crisis_threshold, and threshold-sweep results as binding counterexamples to nearby proposals unless a new mechanism identifies a materially different causal primitive.
Rank A-D against the byte-referee, n=32 dial, and n=256 confirmatory ladder; identify where the unmeasured coverage-onset curve is a prerequisite rather than optional refinement.

Demand a precommitted decision rule for whether deterministic endings are a product regression independent of certification, or an acceptable consequence of the fuller model, so the verdict cannot be selected after seeing a preferred gate.

severity_examples.condition: PATH diversity and terminal OUTCOME diversity are different constructs; silently replacing one with the other would corrupt the meaning of the benchmark and every downstream comparison.
severity_examples.scenario: Option B is adopted while the certification is still described as preserving stochastic century outcomes.

severity_examples.condition: The onset at which terminal variance dies is deliberately unknown, so selecting p from the two endpoints is an unvalidated calibration constant that cannot be sized or independently confirmed.
severity_examples.scenario: Option A receives an edge-sampling probability from the existing 10-country and 218-country endpoints without measuring intermediate coverage.

severity_examples.condition: Existing measurements show uniform topology cuts, propagation rates, crisis thresholds, and T0 re-cuts change location at most, not terminal dispersion.
severity_examples.scenario: A recommendation proposes another uniform scalar or threshold sweep without identifying a new causal primitive.

source_domain: Tibetan Buddhist monastic debate and Indian-Tibetan pramāṇa logic, especially the thesis-reason-pervasion-counterexample discipline used in Gelug debate courtyards.
success_hints: Write each candidate as a thesis-reason-consequence chain and name the exact measured counterexample that would defeat it.
Keep product judgment separate from gate repair: a benchmark can pass a redefined gate while the game still has an undesirable deterministic ending.
Require option A to wait for the intermediate-coverage onset measurement unless a different principled sampling rule is independently justified.
Prefer proposals whose confirmatory test can fail cleanly without another post-hoc threshold or constant.
task_context: Decide how ShadowBench should resolve Phase 6 Stage B given a newly MEASURED result: turning on real 218-country cascade geography makes the century's ending deterministic. Final cat_share is exactly 0.982798835 in all 32 paired seeds (sd 0.000000000, ONE distinct value), versus 32 distinct values spanning 0.486-0.658 at the certified 10-country coverage. Critically, coverage does NOT reduce TIMING dispersion at all -- at matched relative position on each arm's own curve the IQR ratio is 1.03 (50% of ceiling) and 0.89 (60%). The apparent 4x collapse at the certification gate is threshold placement: T0 is a fixed absolute cat_share>0.5, which is 85% of the 10-country ceiling (flat saturating tail) but 51% of the full-world ceiling (steep mid-limb). So jackpot-cal-v2 was converting CEILING spread into TIMING spread, and Stage B raised the ceiling 0.588->0.983 and zeroed its variance, failing incidence (1.0000 vs band [0.90,0.98]) and IQR (45 vs gate 240) from that single cause. No threshold re-cut recovers it: swept 51-100% of ceiling, incidence stays 1.0000 everywhere. Three calibration levers are already falsified with evidence: graph topology (7x mean-degree cut, 2944->411 edges, NO distributional change), propagation_rate (location-only: median 361.5/451.5/519.0, IQR 45.5/43.0/47.0), and crisis_threshold (location-only AND domain-exhausted -- the required value is 4.87 but pressures are clamped to [0,1]). Evaluate and rank four candidate resolutions, and propose better ones if they exist: (A) per-seed seeded edge sampling of the real CEPII graph to restore outcome variance while keeping authoritative geography; (B) re-cut the gates to certify PATH not OUTCOME, keeping epicenter diversity G1 which passed in every arm all session (7-8 distinct epicenters, max share ~0.31) and a T0 median band, dropping IQR; (C) revert Stage B to the certified 10-country graph, losing affordance #7 and the real improvement that CHN epicenter dominance fell 49.4%->8% under true geography; (D) attack the ceiling itself by adding resistance/recovery so countries can genuinely survive and WHICH ones endure becomes seed-dependent, addressing the arguably deeper defect that 98.3% of world GDP ends catastrophic every single run. Weigh: is a deterministic century ending a product regression independent of any gate, or is a 218-country world legitimately more determined than a 10-country toy and the gate should follow the physics? Judge each option on whether it fixes the measured cause rather than its symptom, on certification cost against the existing ladder (byte referee -> n=32 dial -> n=256 confirmatory + mod battery, ~4.5h per n=256 on a 32-core box), and on whether it introduces yet another calibration constant. Note one outstanding measurement, deliberately not run: the ONSET coverage at which outcome variance dies, which needs intermediate coverage points (~1.5h bench) and would be required to size option A's edge probability.
